payload.title: Open the fictional training panel
payload.instructions: Open the fictional training panel described in this exercise. Keep the session in demonstration mode and do not connect to any operational system.

payload.title: Select the practice record
payload.instructions: Select the sample record named TRAINING-ALPHA from the fictional record list. Confirm that its visible label says synthetic training data.

payload.title: Check the demonstration label
payload.instructions: Read the demonstration label on the practice record. Compare the displayed document code with DEMO-WI-001 and leave all real records unchanged.

payload.title: Enter the sample session code
payload.instructions: Enter the sample session code PRACTICE-001 in the training-only text field. Review the characters before continuing to the next fictional step.

payload.title: Review the simulated step list
payload.instructions: Review the simulated step list in the training panel. Confirm that the list begins with step 001 and contains twelve fictional steps.

payload.title: Mark the practice item reviewed
payload.instructions: Set the practice-only review flag for the selected sample item. Add no real approval or production status to any external application.

payload.title: Add a training-only comment
payload.instructions: Add the comment Training example reviewed to the sample comment field. Keep personal details and real customer information out of the exercise.

payload.title: Save the temporary practice result
payload.instructions: Save the fictional practice result in the demonstration session. Confirm that the training panel displays the sample saved indicator.

payload.title: Reopen the saved practice result
payload.instructions: Reopen the saved sample result from the fictional session history. Verify that the practice session code and training-only comment are visible.

payload.title: Compare the displayed sample code
payload.instructions: Compare the displayed sample code with PRACTICE-001. If the characters differ in this exercise, record the difference in a training-only note.

payload.title: Record the training completion note
payload.instructions: Record the note Synthetic exercise complete in the sample result. This note documents only the fictional training session and is not a real work approval.

payload.title: Close the fictional training session
payload.instructions: Review the saved practice result one final time and close the fictional session. The exercise ends without sending information to a real operational system.
